caseContract.planVersion: monotonic integer; every material input or action-graph change creates a new version

leaseAndFencing.dispatchRule: A database compare-and-set claims one outbox row for logicalOperationKey with the current fencing token. Immediately before network dispatch, the dispatcher must atomically confirm the claim and current token; stale holders cannot obtain a dispatch claim.
leaseAndFencing.commitRule: Only the current fencing token may commit local action state. Provider idempotency protects a remote race only when the provider enforces it. For providers without idempotency or provider-side fencing, any dispatch that may have started blocks automatic redispatch until reconciliation positively finds the effect or definitively proves termination/nonexecution.

approvalContract.binding: SHA-256 hash of canonical proposal fields, including exact AND/OR approver requirements and nonwaivable-denial rules
approvalContract.rule: Execution rejects changed arguments, changed logical operation, changed plan version, expired approval, missing required allOf/anyOf authorities, separation-of-duties conflict, or nonwaivable denial.
approvalContract.separationOfDuties: Evaluate named authority IDs, not roles alone. Requestor, approver and executor must be distinct when the rule says so; one person cannot satisfy two allOf roles unless the rule explicitly permits it.

waiverContract.eligibility: The deterministic branch policy enumerates waiver-eligible blocker codes and exact authority IDs/roles. Any unlisted blocker is nonwaivable.
waiverContract.rule: A waiver is tenant-, case-, action-, operation-, plan-, authority-, and blocker-specific; it expires automatically, cannot be reused across cases, and never changes source-system state.

retryPolicy.deadLetter: After max attempts, set manual_repair and notify the accountable owner; never mark complete.

compensationOrdering.rule: Use dependency-aware forward compensation, normally communications correction -> access revocation -> reservation/order cancellation -> enrollment/request cancellation -> document/record correction. Never assume strict reverse order; domain rules and irreversible actions override.
compensationOrdering.onFailure: Persist compensating/manual_repair state and require the accountable specialist to close remaining obligations.

completionRule: A branch disposition is confirmed only when its expectedAuthoritativeState predicate is satisfied by evidence locators for the current material operation. A policy-valid unexpired waiver yields waived, never confirmed. Deterministic applicability evidence yields not_applicable. failed and unknown_external_effect block readiness. Local success flags, model prose, outbound delivery, and attempted API calls do not count.

externalEffectContract.executionAttemptKey: logicalOperationKey + planVersion + attemptOrdinal; identifies local execution only
externalEffectContract.materialInputRule: Hash only inputs that change the intended external effect. Display text, observer lists, retry timing and unrelated branch changes are excluded.
externalEffectContract.effectJournal: Unique logicalOperationKey stores requested, dispatched, unknown, and confirmed provider effects plus provider locator and last reconciled state.
externalEffectContract.replanReuse: A new plan version reuses a confirmed effect when logicalOperationKey is unchanged. Changed material inputs create a new logical operation and explicit supersession/compensation decision.
externalEffectContract.providerIdempotency: Pass logicalOperationKey to providers that support idempotency and require the same key for every retry.
externalEffectContract.ambiguousOutcome: After timeout, lease expiry, worker disappearance, or connection loss once dispatch may have started, read/reconcile provider state by provider locator or business identity. Provider-side idempotency permits retry with the same logical key. Without provider idempotency/fencing, a negative lookup alone is insufficient because a stale request may still execute; automatic redispatch is prohibited unless reconciliation positively identifies the effect or definitively proves provider-side termination/nonexecution. Otherwise set unknown_external_effect and require manual repair.
externalEffectContract.logicalOperationKeyRule: The logical external operation key must not include plan version or attempt number.

applicabilityContract.derivation: A deterministic policy function emits requiredBranchSet entries before branch execution.
rules: not_applicable requires a policy rule ID, version, evaluated inputs hash and reason
waived requires waiver eligibility, named authority ID, proposal binding and unexpired decision
hard-block branches require confirmed and cannot use waived
readiness evaluates only requiredBranchSet; nonrequired branches are preserved as not_applicable rather than fabricated as confirmed
applicabilityContract.dependencyClosure: The planner must reject any requiredBranchSet that is not dependency-closed. Every required branch prerequisite must be always-required, present in the set, or satisfied by an explicit authoritative alternative input binding.
